name: std::multimap<Key,T,Compare,Allocator>::clear
intro:
Erases all elements from the container. After this call, size() returns zero.

Invalidates any references, pointers, and iterators referring to contained elements.
Any past-the-end iterator remains valid.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Linear in the size of the container, i.e., the number of elements.

summary: Erases all elements from the container. After this call, size() returns zero.
